motivation: The singleton local oracle found positive exact-live correction gains at MLP0 and MLP1 but a negative gain at MLP2, while the deployed ship's MLP0-2 residual has large interactions. Singleton gains cannot determine the joint restoration ceiling, whether MLP2 changes sign after upstream restoration, or how much of the same-background MLP0-2 residual is jointly recoverable.
scope: Implementation and CPU-only analysis contract first. Any later scoring must reuse one frozen ship realization and one paired row set. This preregistration does not authorize the exploratory curated-v2 result, create a FineWeb receipt, license a predictor, or overwrite any v1/v2 artifact.

fixed_design.arms: All eight subsets of {mlp0, mlp1, mlp2}, including the empty deployed-ship baseline.
fixed_design.intervention: At every selected site, recompute the exact live original MLP output on that arm's current normalized input and add original-minus-deployed-plank. Downstream selected corrections therefore see the state produced by upstream selected corrections; no cached residual or teacher-forced activation may be injected.
fixed_design.evaluation: Use paired per-row CE from one frozen ship realization and the same rows for all eight arms. Positive gain means baseline deployed-ship CE minus arm CE.
fixed_design.analysis: Run factorial_causal_attribution.analyze_cube on the complete gain cube. Preserve signed singleton, pairwise, and triple Mobius terms and signed Shapley values; require exact cube completeness and numerical closure.
primary_metrics: joint gain divided by the same-row deployed MLP0-2 residual denominator
fixed_design.denominator_rule: The MLP0-2 residual denominator must come from the same ship realization, rows, scoring mask, and CE currency as the subset cube. If unavailable, report the joint gain but leave the fraction null; never import the legacy 0.728-nat Shapley number as a denominator.
fixed_design.runtime_state: The per-site correction selection must be frozen before a forward pass. Existing singleton site/basis/scale behavior remains supported and takes precedence when explicitly selected.
fixed_design.artifact_policy: Any future result uses a new joint-factorial-v1 namespace. Existing curated development v1/v2, preliminary FineWeb, and authoritative canonical artifacts are read-only inputs and must not be overwritten.

interpretation.positive_joint_ceiling: Licenses the early MLP0-2 block as a joint residual target and measures its maximum live-restoration headroom on the tested background. It does not identify a simpler predictor.
interpretation.mlp2_sign_reversal: Supports the hypothesis that MLP2's negative singleton gain was caused by upstream state mismatch; it does not establish a semantic interface.
interpretation.no_sign_reversal: Treat MLP2 as a potentially compensatory plank on this background and do not force an independent exact-restoration target there.
interpretation.large_interaction: Requires future candidate replacements to be evaluated as a joint block or by leave-one-out conditional marginals, not by summing singleton recovery.

failure_policy: Reject incomplete cubes, unequal row counts, non-finite row CE, non-positive supplied denominators, and closure failures. Preserve partial experimental artifacts under a new failed namespace; never reinterpret them as a completed factorial.
